name: RtReflections
description: Kajiya's ray-traced reflections on top of its diffuse global illumination: half resolution GGX rays reused through temporal ReSTIR reservoirs and validated, resolved to full resolution with a ratio estimator over a lobe-shaped kernel, and filtered with surface and reflection reprojection; the diffuse light is the ReSTIR GI example's, with the irradiance cache. Settings are scene.custom.rr.* values; see README.md.
